name: How long does it take to complete an in-law apartment addition?
description: Physical construction generally takes three to six months after permits are approved, depending on whether it is an attached addition or an interior conversion.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete an in-law apartment addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an in-law apartment typically takes between three to six months for physical construction once permits are issued by the local municipality. The overall process begins with an in-person consultation, architectural drawings, and permit review, which can take several weeks depending on local building department workloads. Once construction begins, the phases progress through site preparation, foundation pouring or framing, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing rough-ins, drywall installation, tile and fixture setting, and interior trim. Weather conditions and inspection scheduling can influence the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Physical construction generally takes three to six months after permits are approved, depending on whether it is an attached addition or an interior conversion.
